text:
liz: Heads up — vendor scheduled a SKU swap (a100 -> a500s) during the LIFT window 2024-10-12 02:00-03:00 UTC. I don't have vendor console creds (access expired). Need someone to own quota bumps and SA access before we start.

tony: I opened a quota bump PR for us-east1 https://go/pull/12345 — needs infra approval. That only covers prod-us-east though.

devon: I can take eu quotas. @sre-bot can you re-run the SA rotation job? Liz, which service account needs vendor access?

liz: It's `redwood-sku-deployer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` — I'll add that to the PR description.

raj: Vendor ops said they may need `roles/compute.admin` during the swap. Can we do a temp binding with a time condition? Vendor said rollback could be +30m.

tony: We have infra/iam/temproles module to do timebound bindings. I'll open a small TF PR and tag security for a 1hr exception.

sre-bot: Deploybot: terraform plan available at https://ci.redwood/plan/987 — shows new timebound binding added. :white_check_mark:

liz: Please avoid granting full `compute.admin` if possible. Security prefers least privilege — maybe `compute.instances.admin` + disk perms only.

raj: Vendor claims their deploy script requires compute.admin. I'll ask them to test with restricted perms in staging.

vendor-bob: We can try the restricted perm test in staging today and confirm. If it fails we'll request compute.admin for the window.

devon: If vendor can't change the script, we can create a peri-scope: temp compute.admin with a strict start/end condition (02:00-03:00 UTC) and audit logging. I'll file a quick RFC in #eng-security.

tony: PR: https://go/pull/12367 — includes the timebound binding 2024-10-12T02:00:00Z -> 2024-10-12T03:00:00Z. @liz can you review? Need to merge ~40m before window.

liz: On it. Also need to rotate vendor portal key after merge. Steps: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create key.json --iam-account=redwood-sku-deployer@...` then upload key to Vault. I'll rotate once PR is merged.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: I'll post maintenance notice to #eng-notify at 2024-10-12T01:30:00Z unless you cancel. :bell:

raj: Please post. Also add fallback: if swap fails, revert images and park burst pools for 30m to limit impact.

liz: Added fallback notes to PR description and included rollback commands.

devon: I'll be oncall for that window — ping me for any 5xx/errors or quota spikes.

tony: Thanks all. Merging once liz approves; tagging @security for visibility.

security: Reviewed PR, added comment to scope resources down to instance+disk operations where possible. Timebound exception approved with audit requirement.

liz: Approved. Merging now. :shipit:

tony: Merged. Will watch logs and post update here once vendor confirms swap complete.

vendor-bob: Confirmed staging test passed with restricted perms — we'll proceed with timebound compute.admin in prod as fallback. ETA 02:10 UTC.

sre-bot: Note: post-mortem reminder scheduled if rollback happens. :memo:
